rules.name: recon-failed-run-position-mapping-dev
rules.sql: SELECT uuid, business_unit, view_type, resolved_settlement_date, resolved_value_date, status, row_count, profile_key, processor_plan, error_message, requested_by, requested_at, started_at, completed_at FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE uuid = cast(:run_id AS uuid)

SELECT uuid, business_unit, view_type, resolved_value_date, status, row_count, left(error_message, 200) AS error_message, requested_at FROM opera.recon_refresh_run ORDER BY requested_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS rows_n, min(effective_from) AS min_from, max(effective_to) AS max_to FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:r.business_unit)) GROUP BY business_unit
SELECT :r.view_type AS view_type, count(*) AS rows_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h_p IS NULL) AS rows_without_h_p FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot WHERE run_id = cast(:run_id AS uuid)

SELECT d.portfolio, d.subportfolio, d.trade_group, d.deal_rows FROM ( SELECT portfolio, subportfolio, upper(trim(:r.business_unit)) AS trade_group, count(*) AS deal_rows FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE upper(trim(business_unit)) = upper(trim(:r.business_unit)) AND is_latest_version = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2 ) d WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_position_classification_input m WHERE upper(trim(m.business_unit)) = upper(trim(:r.business_unit)) AND upper(trim(m.portfolio)) = upper(trim(d.portfolio)) AND upper(trim(m.subportfolio)) = upper(trim(d.subportfolio)) AND m.trade_group = d.trade_group AND :r.resolved_value_date >= m.effective_from AND (m.effective_to IS NULL OR :r.resolved_value_date <= m.effective_to)) ORDER BY d.deal_rows DESC

expect.reason: every deal key of the run BU needs a mapping on the run value date
